name: infinityrx-platform
description: InfinityRx platform monorepo. SP-0 establishes packages/* workspaces alongside the existing portal/ workspaces.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:root && npm run lint:portal-operator
scripts.test:packages: npm --workspace=@infinityrx/scripts test && npm --workspace=@infinityrx/contract test && npm --workspace=@infinityrx/auth test && npm --workspace=@infinityrx/ui test && npm --workspace=@infinityrx/qa-harness test && npm --workspace=@infinityrx/shell test && npm --workspace=@infinityrx/module-prescriber-directory test && npm --workspace=@infinityrx/module-paysync test
scripts.composition:check: npm --workspace=@infinityrx/scripts run validate-manifest -- infrastructure/manifests/operator-dev.yml && npm --workspace=@infinityrx/scripts run build-manifest
